## How to test

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npx gulp build_github` succeeds, acorn ES5 check green
- [ ] New behavior covered by a spec in `spec/` (or N/A — no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [ ] Fork override lives in `src/custom/*` and is registered in `src/custom/index.js`
- [ ] `public/autoload.json` untouched (or reviewed per security skill if changed)
- [ ] `docs/en` + `docs/ru` updated if user-facing
